description: Live health, streaming, chat, and infrastructure metrics for hctv across every MediaMTX region

panels.title: MediaMTX Regions Up
panels.description: Number of MediaMTX regions Prometheus is currently able to scrape. Unaffected by the region filter so a missing region is always visible.
One tile per scraped MediaMTX region. Tiles are generated from the region variable, so a new region appears here as soon as Prometheus scrapes it.
panels.title: MediaMTX — $region

panels.description: Scrape availability per region over time. Gaps mean Prometheus could not reach that region's metrics endpoint.
panels.title: Region Availability
Active Paths by Region
panels.description: Paths the MediaMTX server itself reports, next to what the web app's stream sync saw on its last scrape. A lasting gap between the two means sync is falling behind that region.

panels.title: Ingest Connections by Region
panels.description: Publisher and reader connections per protocol. WHIP publishing is only enabled on some regions, so webrtc series are expected to be empty elsewhere.

panels.title: HLS Delivery by Region
panels.description: HLS sessions count requesters hitting the origin directly, which is the Cloudflare edge worker rather than individual viewers. Use Viewers by Region for audience size.

panels.title: Frame Loss by Region
panels.description: Frames per second dropped on ingest or discarded on delivery. Sustained non-zero values point at an overloaded region or a broadcaster sending more than the region can forward.

panels.title: SRT Round Trip by Region
panels.description: Average SRT round trip time across live connections in each region. Idle regions report zero.

panels.title: Playback Events by Region
panels.description: Browser-reported playback lifecycle events. Stalls, resyncs, and recoveries rising together in one region is the earliest sign of a delivery problem there.

panels.title: Playback Startup Time by Region
panels.description: Time from loading a stream to playback starting. A p95 above eight seconds is the documented alert threshold.

panels.title: Buffer Ahead by Region
panels.description: Forward buffer reported by hls.js. A p50 below four seconds is the documented alert threshold.

panels.title: Viewer Bandwidth Estimate by Region
panels.description: Bandwidth hls.js estimates for viewers. Until an ABR ladder exists every viewer needs to clear the broadcaster's bitrate, so the p10 matters more than the median.

panels.title: Stalls per Viewer Minute by Region
panels.description: More than one stall per viewer-minute is the documented alert threshold.

panels.title: Audience Pulse
panels.description: Top stream and streams-with-viewers are platform-wide totals and do not narrow with the region filter.

panels.title: Media Auth Outcomes by Region
panels.description: Regions report themselves through the region query parameter on MTX_AUTHHTTPADDRESS. A region that has not been redeployed with that parameter reports as "unknown".

panels.title: Service Memory
panels.description: MediaMTX does not export process metrics, so region memory is not available here.

list.description: MediaMTX regions, discovered from every series carrying a region label. Adding a region to Prometheus is enough for it to show up here.
